text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and understand why it happens. Debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, can help you examine your code closely. A systematic approach is also essential. Instead of changing many things at once, test one part at a time and check the results. Logging is another useful strategy. By adding log messages, you can see what your program is doing and spot errors more easily. With practice, debugging becomes faster and less stressful.
